name: Sadia Akter
headline: I turn ideas into visual impact.
tagline: Creative Content Designer & AI-Assisted Video Editor
intro: I create visual content that brings ideas to life and helps brands communicate through thoughtful design.
about: I'm Sadia Akter, a social media content creator and AI-assisted video editor. I make social media posts, carousel designs, website banners, promotional campaigns and AI-assisted video content, and I design social media posters in Figma.

My work sits where design meets digital marketing and e-commerce. I have worked with Leadmark Communications, and I have hands-on experience with Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, Amazon Vendor Central, Zoho Inventory and Canva.
This portfolio brings together creative work I have made for four brands — Cricket Arabia, Cubuzzle, Active Arabia and Tourmatez.
